name: Advanced Power System Analysis and Optimization Lab
description: Newton Raphson load flow. AGCLF and fast decoupled load flow. Fault analysis (symmetrical and unsymmetrical faults). State estimation. Overload security analysis. Voltage security and CPF. Economic load dispatch. Unit commitment. Optimal power flow. Energy market clearing with nodal pricing.
